lyrics.text: Winter on the beach and the gulls are gone
Kite in my hands but the wind's moved on
Building us a castle like we did back then
June, you'd laugh, I'm fifteen again
But the water always wins
It takes the walls, it takes the towers in
No matter how I build, no matter where I've been
The water always wins
Dad doesn't call and Mom's in the ground
June's in a picture that I turn around
I don't feel sad, I don't feel a thing
Just the cold in my hands and a broken string
But the water always wins
It takes the walls, it takes the towers in
No matter how I build, no matter where I've been
The water always wins
Higher than the gulls, higher than the sun
Nothing's ever ending when you're fifteen and young
But the water always wins
It takes the walls, it takes the towers in
No matter how I build, no matter where I've been
The water always wins
